title: E2 — upstream calls vs. surface variation of the arguments (W-syn, H5)
description: Sweep of the fraction of URLs written in an equivalent but different form (upper-case host, default port, reordered query, fragment) at the base workload. It isolates what producer-declared canonicalization adds over B5, the shared exact-match cache at the gateway keyed by the arguments as sent (ADR-036): B5 sees two spellings as two keys, IDEM's name sees one. At 0 every repeated call is spelled the same way, so B5 and B2 can differ only by in-flight aggregation (B5 sends identical calls that are in flight at the same time upstream; the PIT absorbs them). B1 keys on the canonical name, as in every sweep. Same seeds at every point; reductions are paired by seed against B0, B1 and B5.
